incarnation: Mirelle Suture — Nexus de Convergence, pack original complet A.R.C.A. (2026)

slots.poseBrief: Standing in a relaxed three-quarter stance, right arm resting naturally at her side and left palm supporting ONE hovering turquoise data card at waist height; chin lifted toward camera, long coat parted just enough to show matching dark teal trousers and boots. No attack.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original A.R.C.A. archive-window alcove in the Mosaic City Atrium.

slots.poseBrief: Tool-only study with no person or hands: three turquoise rectangular data cards, one face-on and two slightly angled behind it, white cross-like data mark, thin white/cyan inner border and gold outer rim, floating over an open black-and-gold card case.

Environment-only wide interior with no figures, cards or weapons: two curving rows of ivory archive shelves surround a recessed circular reading pit, suspended gold archive rings above a tall turquoise prism, strong open central depth.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original Static Archives reading hall in Mosaic City.

slots.poseBrief: Seated sideways on a plain work stool at an archive terminal, torso inclined toward one hovering data card; left hand steadies the card and right fingertip traces a short golden stitch between two separated turquoise nodes. Both feet planted, coat and pointed hat unchanged.

slots.themeBrief: Suture du Voile — aptitude du jeu
slots.poseBrief: Wide asymmetrical lunge, left knee bent and right leg extended, left hand sweeping upward and right hand guiding a fan of turquoise data cards; thin cyan and gold threads stitch an abstract coral tear into a stable ring. No extra limbs or weapons.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original A.R.C.A. causal-rupture training courtyard; explicit game adaptation of Suture du Voile.

slots.poseBrief: Walking through a large open archway, left boot crossing the threshold and right hand lifting the broad hat brim a little in greeting; left hand carries a closed small black-and-gold card case. Coat swings naturally, face and hat retain source identity.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original covered bridge leading into the Static Archives.

slots.themeBrief: Une mémoire a retrouvé son nom
slots.poseBrief: Standing tall on a low pedestal, one foot placed on the next step, right hand raising a single restored data card above shoulder height and left hand over the heart; proud restrained expression, hat and coat intact.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original terrace around a restored A.R.C.A. name beacon.

slots.poseBrief: Kneeling on the right knee behind a low broken ivory plinth, left boot braced, torso leaning back; left forearm protects the face while right hand gathers two dim data cards near the chest. Intact body, living regroup, no injuries or gore.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original A.R.C.A. backup-service passage after a failed defense.

slots.poseBrief: Family-only leisure variant, age unchanged and unspecified: kneeling on a dry wooden landing, both hands folding a tiny paper boat beside a shallow garden lagoon. Keep the complete source long coat, dark trousers, boots and pointed hat; one data card hovers nearby as a soft reading light. No swimwear or romance.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original garden beach and sheltered lagoon in a Mosaic City recreation quarter.

slots.poseBrief: Family-only professional service variant: taking a short side step while both hands carry a tray of closed water flasks toward an archive rest counter. A plain ivory work apron is worn OVER the same long dark gold-trimmed coat, leaving source brooch visible; same hat, hair, boots. No romantic or submissive pose.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original staff rest counter in an A.R.C.A. archive quarter.

slots.themeBrief: Le courant d’air et les cartes
slots.poseBrief: Controlled comic balance: on tiptoe, torso tilting forward, left hand pinning the pointed hat onto the head while right hand reaches for three harmless data cards drifting toward an air vent; long coat follows the breeze. Same identity and equipment, no mutation or fall.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original A.R.C.A. portal lobby with an overenthusiastic ventilation grille.

slots.poseBrief: Explicit alternative moral alignment, not campaign canon: three-quarter rear view, Mirelle turns her face back toward camera while one hand closes an unmarked black ledger and the other holds a data card whose inner mark is blank. Source hat, hair, gold-trimmed coat, trousers and boots unchanged, no new armor or weapon.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original blank-index archive annex in an alternative Sans-Auteur branch.

slots.poseBrief: Single explicit masculine-presenting reinterpretation, family-safe, age unchanged and unspecified; preserve long black hair, warm skin, amber-brown eyes, the same broad pointed black hat with gold band, long dark gold-filigree coat, ivory cravat, teal trousers and boots. Seated astride a low bench facing its back, arms resting on the bench back, chin on one glove; one turquoise card floats beside the shoulder. No other costume swap.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original A.R.C.A. greenhouse used to study stable causal maps.

slots.poseBrief: Explicit noncanon memory corruption by erased absence: standing with weight shifted unevenly, left fingertips at the temple and right palm holding a dim data card; a few small coral-and-black missing-pixel gaps affect ONLY the coat hem and a card corner. Face, two arms, two legs and source costume remain intact, no wounds, zombie flesh or extra anatomy.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original A.R.C.A. memory quarantine chamber for an alternative corruption scenario.

slots.themeBrief: Avenir alternatif — cinq ans de sutures
slots.poseBrief: One hypothetical future five years after the campaign opening, not a new canon biography; same age-undetermined source face and anatomy, slightly repaired hem on the SAME long gold-trimmed coat, same hat and data cards. Walking in full side profile along a narrow archive balcony, rear heel lifting, left hand holding a restored turquoise memory prism and right hand resting lightly on the railing.
slots.backgroundDescription: Original expanded archive canopy walkway in a hypothetical later Mosaic City.
